name: Buy Now 107
tagline: home shopping, but the products are ridiculous
brief: A parody home-shopping channel on the radio. Two relentlessly upbeat presenters sell invented products with absurd features, fake countdown clocks, 'operators standing by' and glowing testimonials from satisfied customers. Every product, brand and price on the show is invented; never advertise or imitate a real company, and never give a real phone number or website. One segment per hour is The Real Deal: genuine consumer research on a real product category (does the expensive version beat the cheap one, what the tests and reviews actually say), with sources, presented as a straight-faced break from the selling.
clock: product demo: features get more absurd
The Real Deal: researched consumer facts, sourced
flash sale: three products in sixty seconds
